description:
WealthPulse: Personal finance intelligence API. 12 endpoints grounded in live FRED rate data — financial health, retirement, debt, credit cards, mortgage, Social Security, tax optimization, Roth vs Traditional, em

Coverage: Global

Endpoints:
  • snapshot ($0.15): Financial health snapshot
  • retire ($0.15): Retirement readiness projection
  • debt ($0.10): Avalanche vs snowball debt payoff strategy
  • cards ($0.10): Best credit card for your spending profile
  • mortgage ($0.10): How much house can I afford
  • debt-negotiate ($0.15): Can I settle this debt for less
  • advisor ($0.10): Financial advisor finder, comparison, and background check
  • ssa ($0.15): Social Security claiming strategy
  • tax ($0.15): Year-end tax optimization
  • roth ($0.10): Roth vs Traditional IRA/401k decision
  • emergency ($0.10): Emergency fund sizing
  • inheritance ($0.10): Inherited IRA and estate rules
  • trump-account ($0.15): Trump Account (IRC §530A) eligibility, strategy, and rules
  • bank-health ($0.25): Is my bank safe? FDIC Call Report bank-health check
  • bank-check ($0.02): FDIC bank-health check — deterministic Call Report primitive
  • unclaimed ($0.50): Find unclaimed money owed to you
  • card-benefit ($0.05): Credit-Card Benefit Coverage Check
  • card-benefit-pack ($2.00): Card-Benefit Claim Pack
  • card-benefit-preview ($0.25): Card-Benefit Coverage PREVIEW

action.description: Required. One of: find, compare, vet.

advisors.description: Required for action=compare (e.g. "Advisor A 1% AUM, Advisor B flat fee")

bank.description: Bank name or FDIC certificate (CERT) number

birth_year.description: Year of birth (used to calculate Full Retirement Age)

budget_yearly.description: For action=strategy: how much can be contributed per year, in USD

cardholder_name.description: Name for the cover note (placeholder if omitted)

child_age.description: For action=strategy: the child's current age

countries.description: Comma-separated non-US jurisdictions: CA (Canada), GB, CH, AU, AU-VIC, AU-NSW

creditor.description: The collector or original creditor name

delay_hours.description: Trip delay: hours delayed (triggers are 6h or 12h by card tier)

employer_match.description: Whether your employer offers a 401k match (yes/no)

employer_program.description: For action=strategy: does an employer offer a Trump Account matching program

extra.description: Extra monthly payment available in USD (optional)

firm.description: Optional firm name; used alongside name for action=vet

goal.description: For action=strategy: the savings goal for this child

has_ssn.description: For action=eligibility: does the child have a Social Security Number

incident_date.description: Damage/theft/delay date YYYY-MM-DD — filing deadlines computed from this

issuer.description: Card issuer slug (chase, amex, capital-one, citi, hsbc, discover, amex-uk, rbc)

item_price.description: Item price — recoverable estimate = min(price, cap) - deductible

original_owner_age.description: Original owner's age at time of death

phone_paid_on_card.description: Cell phone: was the prior month's wireless bill paid on this card

prior_election.description: For action=eligibility: has an account already been elected for this child

purchase_date.description: Item/ticket purchase date YYYY-MM-DD (eligibility windows + warranty math)

situation.description: Optional free-text context about your situation

situations.description: Life events unlocking federal/special sources: former_pension | failed_bank | failed_credit_union | fha_mortgage | savings_bonds | deceased_relative | old_employer | moved_states | former_business

specialty.description: Required for action=find (e.g. retirement planning, tax, estate, investment)

spend_profile.description: Required. Free text, e.g. travel, dining, groceries, gas, cashback.

ssn_work_valid.description: For action=eligibility: is that SSN valid for employment, issued before election

states.description: Comma-separated US state codes you have lived/worked in (e.g. CA,TX,NY)

topic.description: For action=rules (optional): focus the rules answer on this topic

us_citizen.description: For action=eligibility: is the child a US citizen. Required for the $1,000 pilot only — NOT required for the account itself.

warranty_years.description: Extended warranty: original manufacturer warranty length

name: wealthpulse
